conditions: despite more than two years of work

statement.excerpt: Especially when we just saw GPT-5 (ultimately relabeled as GPT 4.5) fail despite more than two years of hard and expensive work.
statement.document_title: Ezra Klein’s new take on AGI – and why I think it’s probably wrong

our_interpretation: Read this as a conjunction: the project intended as GPT-5 became GPT-4.5, missed intended capability goals, and involved more than two years of costly development.
Failure ordinarily means missing the intended capability advance in this context. It does not mean no product shipped or no improvements occurred.
More than two years is a duration claim, not a forecast condition.
The described period is the project’s development through its recent release. The post supplies no exact start date.
Expensive is a qualitative spending assertion without a currency, accounting basis, or amount. Those details are not inferred from unrelated company spending.
criteria.support_condition: Reliable project records or corroborated reporting establish the original intended identity, subsequent GPT-4.5 release, missed capability goals, development exceeding two years, and substantial project expenditure.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable project records refute an essential component, such as the intended identity, duration exceeding two years, or failure to meet the original capability goals.
